name: Tether USD

description.en: Custom Tether USD token implementation with advanced DeFi features including 6-month auto-burn mechanism and Chainlink price oracle integration for real-time USD valuations.

public_notice: This is a custom implementation of USDT using official Tether branding. It is a separate smart contract from the official Tether USD mainnet address (0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7). Deployed on Ethereum/Sepolia testnet.
